args.body: generation 3: Ecology is the one layer with any purchase here, and only sideways: a longer-lived fly is a fly exposed to predation for longer. The databases cannot tell us the lifespan, but they can tell us what is on record as eating this animal and whether any of it is in the place we are asking about.
